question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
-- Final clean version with proper integer types
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        n.name,
        m.id as movie_id,
        m.date_published,
        m.duration,
        r.avg_rating,
        r.total_votes,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dm.name_id ORDER BY m.date_published) as rn
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
),
inter_durations AS (
    SELECT 
        dm1.name_id,
        dm1.name,
        dm1.movie_id,
        dm1.date_published,
        dm1.duration,
        dm1.avg_rating,
        dm1.total_votes,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (dm1.date_published - LAG(dm1.date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY dm1.name_id ORDER BY dm1.date_published))) / 86400.0 as days_between
    FROM director_movies dm1
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        name,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        ROUND(AVG(days_between), 0) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,
        SUM(total_votes) as total_votes,
        ROUND(MIN(avg_rating), 2) as min_rating,
        ROUND(MAX(avg_rating), 2) as max_rating,
        SUM(duration) as total_movie_duration
    FROM inter_durations
    GROUP BY name_id, name
)
SELECT 
    name_id,
    name,
    movie_count,
    CAST(avg_inter_movie_duration AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
    avg_rating,
    CAST(total_votes AS INTEGER) as total_votes,
    min_rating,
    max_rating,
    CAST(total_movie_duration AS INTEGER) as total_movie_duration
FROM director_stats
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
